description: Pre-configured synthetic test scenarios for LandShield evaluation

S1.name: Double Sale Attempt
S1.description: Seller A sells 30 decimals to X (unmutated), then sells the same 30 decimals to Y

S2.name: Seller Not Recorded Owner
S2.description: Stranger Z attempts to sell land on Plot 2 without prior holding

S3.name: Missing Mutation Over 90 Days
S3.description: Active deed registered 120 days ago with no completed mutation

S4.name: Rapid Transfers (4 deeds within 20 days)
S4.description: 4 legitimate sequential transfers on Plot 4 within a 20-day span

S5.name: Flagged Land (Khas / Disputed with Open Case)
S5.description: Plot 5 is designated as khas and disputed land with an open court case

S6.name: Clean Land Deal
S6.description: Happy path: 2 sequential, fully mutated land transfers on Plot 6

S7.name: Legitimate Pending Resale
S7.description: Buyer B resells land to C before mutation of A->B completes; valid in ledger

S8.name: Partial Sales by Same Owner
S8.description: Owner A sells 10 decimals to B and 10 decimals to C out of 30, keeping 10

L1.name: Missing SA Survey Generation
L1.description: Historical survey chain skips SA generation (CS -> RS -> BS)

L2.name: Orphan RS Survey Khatian
L2.description: RS survey khatian has no documented parent in earlier surveys

L3.name: Unjustified Area Expansion
L3.description: Documented plot area expands from 20 to 35 decimals across surveys without lawful basis

R1.name: Record Owner Differs from Mutation History
R1.description: Plot current_owner_id in AC Land registry differs from largest deed record holder

R2.name: Mutation Stalled Beyond Statutory Limit
R2.description: Mutation application has remained stuck in review longer than MUTATION_DAYS

R3.name: Area Holdings Not Conserved
R3.description: Sum of citizen deed holdings does not equal recorded plot area

C1.name: Clean Survey Lineage & Reconciliation
C1.description: Perfect chain of title across all 4 historical surveys (CS -> SA -> RS -> BS) with area conservation
